name: Lumen Protocol
tagline: A made up lending app, for testing Quests.

lessons.title: What is Lumen?
lessons.text: Lumen is a lending app. You can deposit tokens to earn interest, or borrow against tokens you already hold.

lessons.title: Supplying
lessons.text: When you supply tokens to a Lumen pool, borrowers pay interest, and that interest is shared with everyone who supplied.

lessons.title: Borrowing
lessons.text: To borrow, you lock collateral worth more than the loan. For example, lock $150 of tokens to borrow $100.

lessons.title: Health factor
lessons.text: Your health factor shows how safe your loan is. Above 1 is safe. If it drops below 1, your loan can be liquidated.

lessons.title: Liquidations
lessons.text: If your collateral loses value, part of it is sold to repay the loan, plus a penalty. Adding collateral or repaying early avoids it.

lessons.title: Staying safe
lessons.text: Only use the official Lumen site, keep an eye on your health factor, and never share your seed phrase. Rates change all the time.
